CustomField.label: Price Option
CustomField.description: Drives which AttributeBasedAdjustment condition is matched when this specific parent/child component relationship is selected as a bundle option (see RES_ResidentialBundlePricingHook). Lives on the relationship record - not on the child Product2 - because the same child product can be reused as a component under multiple bundles, each needing its own price option value.
